purpose: Aggregate comparison reference for release-evidence and public procurement review.

methods.release_evidence: Use full revision and content identifiers to match pinned public receipts, then apply documented evidence gates. Check decisions, material fact attribution, and unsupported release decisions.
methods.procurement_review: Resolve canonical links from official notice listings, read authoritative notice status and amendments, then apply documented relevance and access checks. Check decisions, material fact attribution and supplier eligibility assertions.
methods.verification: The independent evaluator froze the expected outcomes before observing the qualification artifacts. Five complete local replays of the conventional workflows produced byte-identical decision outputs.
methods.timing_scope: Wall and process CPU measurements cover local execution from staged public evidence to decision files with evidence references. Reported counts cover tested observations.

limitations: Initial public retrieval, data preparation, implementation, reading, and human review are outside the reported timing scope.

The evaluator configured the conventional workflow against the available source format. The first procurement implementation required a correction for truncated listing titles before the reported repeated runs.
The bounded cases provide a comparison reference. Generalization and operational human savings require separate measurements.
